name: BTC transaction throughput healthy + band washout — on-chain-supported dip (spot long)
rationale: MECHANISM (why healthy throughput leads a bounce): when price is statistically washed out (bb_z stretched below its band) but on-chain settlement throughput (btc_tx_count) stays healthy, the sell-off is speculative, not a demand collapse — a divergence between real usage and price. Sticky on-chain activity anchors the recovery, so the healthy-throughput read leads the mean-reversion. This is the THROUGHPUT analogue of the active-addresses divergence spec, paired with a BAND washout (bb_z) rather than RSI for a different, volatility-relative over-extension gauge. Exit when bb_z reverts to the mean. DISCONFIRMER 1: if the bb_z washout alone matches the deflated Sharpe, tx-count adds nothing. DISCONFIRMER 2 (non-stationarity): tx-count drifted structurally, so a fitted floor risks always-true — if it never actually excludes low-usage bars, no divergence is captured and the Gate must kill it. Data knowable T+1; tier1, low-confidence until OOS.
catalyst: btc_tx_count stays elevated (real usage intact) while bb_z shows a downside washout — price weak, chain busy.
